$schema: Session state schema for agent-session skill
description: YouTube video presentation about a tax prep agent built with Claude Code. Slides support specific video segments.

high_level: Create Slidev slides supporting the YouTube video's slide-based segments
Clearly communicate system architecture, value proposition, and workflow
mid_level: Why It Matters — single slide, three-to-one-takeaway, bespoke > generic message
Architecture — 6 slides (system overview + 5 phases), Terminal + FileExplorer + AgentView, progressive directory growth
Key Results — single slide, adaptability + low cost + time savings

key_decisions.decision: Slides cover three sections: Why It Matters, Architecture, and Key Results
key_decisions.rationale: Other sections are talking head or screen recording — slides would not add value there.

key_decisions.decision: Architecture diagrams built in-slide with CSS/HTML, not Mermaid
key_decisions.rationale: Ford doesn't like Mermaid's visual style. Prefers custom-designed diagrams using Tailwind/CSS.

key_decisions.decision: Architecture section uses progressive file directory as primary visualization
key_decisions.rationale: The file directory IS the data flow. More concrete than abstract flowcharts — shows what actually exists on disk.

key_decisions.decision: Phase slides use Terminal + FileExplorer + AgentView components
key_decisions.rationale: System runs in terminal — slides should simulate the real experience of using it.

key_decisions.decision: System overview shows actual .claude/ file names, only cpa-tax-prep in detail
key_decisions.rationale: pdf and xlsx skills exist but aren't the focus — just list them without expanding.

key_decisions.decision: Why It Matters uses three-to-one-takeaway template
key_decisions.rationale: Three pain points → one takeaway lands the bespoke > generic message. Ties into brand philosophy.

key_decisions.decision: Key Results template deferred to plan phase
key_decisions.rationale: Better to evaluate all available templates during planning rather than committing now.
